chunks: Al-Husayn ibn ʿUbayd Allah informed me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad ibn ʿAli ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad, from his father, from ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Mughirah, from ʿUmar ibn Yazid, who said:

ʿAmr ibn Saʿid ibn Hilal narrated to me, saying: I asked Aba Jaʿfar عليه السلام about what falls into the well, from a mouse and a cat up to a sheep. So he said: For all of that, seven buckets are prescribed. He said: Then when I reached the donkey and the camel, he said: A kurr of water.

key_terms.السِّنَّوْرِ: a cat, included among the animals for which the same ruling applies
key_terms.الشَّاةِ: a sheep, marking the upper range of the first category of animals
key_terms.الْبِئْرِ: the well whose water is being discussed in the legal ruling
key_terms.الْجَمَلَ: a camel, included with the larger animals in the ruling
key_terms.الْحِمَارَ: a donkey, mentioned among the larger animals requiring a different measure
key_terms.الْفَأْرَةِ: a mouse, mentioned as one of the smaller animals falling into the well
key_terms.سَبْعُ دِلَاءٍ: seven buckets to be drawn from the well as the prescribed measure
key_terms.كُرٌّ مِنْ مَاءٍ: a kurr of water, the larger prescribed measure in this context

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a well when different animals fall into it according to Imam Aba Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a well into which animals fall. Imam Aba Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that for animals ranging from a mouse or cat up to a sheep, seven buckets are to be drawn, while for larger animals such as a donkey or camel, the measure is a kurr of water.
